description: Asset Infrastructure - Building is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. The Building Feature Class sits within the National Parks and Wildlife Service (NPWS) Assets Geodatabase. The Building point layer includes Accommodation, Amenities, Commercial/Retail premises and Sheds. It also includes private buildings adjacent to Parks tagged as "Threatened Property" for emergency services. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Its tags are Assets. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
